text:
maya: Heads-up — overnight EU-west GPU pool showed a sustained ~20% utilization bump with short network hiccups between az-a and az-b. KV cache warmups slowed; saw queueing for 2x 30s windows. Not full outage but burst smoothing didn't behave as expected. Can we discuss quick guardrail tweaks?
oliver: saw the same logs, +1. Packet drop spikes around 03:12 and 03:19 UTC. Looks like transient infra networking, not model frag. Do we want to temporarily tighten burst cap or increase steady-state headroom?
zara: if the network is the culprit, increasing steady headroom helps latency but costs $$. Could we try more aggressive decay for burst tokens so we don't overshoot when redis recover? :thinking:
maya: thinking: reduce burst window from 10m -> 5m and lower burst multiplier from 2.0 -> 1.4, and add a conservative network penalty to routing score. Quick experiment?
sam: +1 to experiment. Also want to add hysteresis on AZ failover: require 3 consecutive failures before draining to avoid flip-flop.
priya: FYI costs: that steady headroom delta is ~0.9 GPU-hours/hr for eu-west peak. If we only tighten burst, we save ~0.6 GPU-hours/hr but might see degraded p95. Tradeoff noted.
oncall-bot: Incident alert created: INC-2026-1842 (EU-west transient packet loss). Priority: low.
maya: I'll open a canary change on staging with config below and run a 3h soak. If green, we push to prod with 1h overlap. Patch:
```yaml
autoscaling:
  burst_window: 300s   # 5m
  burst_multiplier: 1.4
  reserve_headroom: 0.12 # fraction of pool
  az_fail_hysteresis: 3  # consecutive failures
  network_penalty_weight: 0.25
```
zara: can we also add a short rolling eviction for preemptible mix during network churn to reduce tail latency? e.g. preemptible_evict_threshold: 0.8
maya: good call — add that to canary.
sam: I'll wire up a quick dashboard: p50/p95/p99, queue length, network drops, preemptible eviction rate. We should capture before/after.
priya: will run cost delta calc post-canary. If the p95 regression is <10% and cost delta <0.5 GPU-hrs/hr, we can accept.
oliver: timeline?
maya: canary start in ~20m, soak 3h, then roll with 1h overlap. I'll post updates.
priya: thanks! :rocket:
oliver: thanks — standing by for rollback plan in the thread.
maya: rollback: revert autoscaling config and re-enable previous burst_window/multiplier; cordon new AZ routing rules. Simple yaml revert and restart-autoscaler job. I'll paste playbook if needed.
zara: ack. ping me if canary shows >5% p99 increase.
maya: will do.
